modifications: Restricted ordinary model construction and weight sanitization to the trunk; MTP is not declared as a serving capability.

Removed the source's MTP sidecar module, mtp_step and MTP weight remap (the runtime model is trunk-only and drops sidecar tensors); kept an identity-bound, header-only depth-1 MTP sidecar inspector (adapters/hy_v3_mtp.py). No MTP loader exists and normal serving does not call the inspector.
Added a full-KV APCv2 cache layout and explicit cache factory.

Defaulted router_scaling_factor (2.826) and enable_moe_fp32_combine (True) to the reference HYV3Config values instead of the source's 1.0 / False; the adapter refuses enable_attention_fp32_softmax, which is not implemented.
Added CPU-only exact full and REAP50 topology checks, including the 96-expert trunk and 192-expert sidecar distinction.
validation: CPU-only full and REAP artifact inspection and static tests; no model weights loaded, MLX import, GPU execution, or serving qualification.
